description: Implementation of the ShoppingCartService interface, providing core shopping cart operations such as retrieval, saving, updating, and merging shopping carts, as well as populating cart and cart item details, and shipping calculations.

classes.name: ShoppingCartServiceImpl
classes.description: A service class that implements shopping cart operations such as retrieval, update, deletion, population, merging, and shipping calculations within an e-commerce platform.

methods.name: getShoppingCart
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart for a specific customer, populating its details and removing obsolete carts.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Save a new shopping cart or update an existing one.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart by ID and store, with population and obsolescence check.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart by ID, updating its details and obsolescence status.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart by code and store, with population and obsolescence check.

methods.name: getByCustomer
methods.description: Retrieve a shopping cart associated with a specific customer.

methods.name: populateShoppingCart
methods.description: Populate shopping cart items with current product and attribute details, updating or obsoleting as needed.

methods.name: populateShoppingCartItem
methods.description: Create and populate a shopping cart item based on a product, including price calculation.

methods.name: populateItem
methods.description: Populate a shopping cart item with product details, attributes, and pricing.

methods.name: createShippingProduct
methods.description: Create shipping product representations for shippable items in the cart.

methods.name: isFreeShoppingCart
methods.description: Determine if the shopping cart is free based on item prices.

methods.name: requiresShipping
methods.description: Check if the shopping cart requires shipping based on products' shippability.

methods.name: removeShoppingCart
methods.description: Remove a shopping cart from persistence.

methods.name: mergeShoppingCarts
methods.description: Merge two shopping carts, combining items and updating quantities.

methods.name: getShoppingCartItems
methods.description: Retrieve shopping cart items from session cart, preparing for merge.
